segments.he: דְּהָא קַנְיַהּ בַּהֲוָיָה. וְאִי בַּת יִשְׂרָאֵל לְכֹהֵן הִיא — לֹא מַאֲכִיל לָהּ מִשּׁוּם דְּעוּלָּא.
segments.en: «as he acquired her by means of betrothal. And if she is an Israelite woman» betrothed «to a priest, he does not enable her to partake» of teruma «due to» the reason given by «Ulla:» Although by Torah law a priest’s betrothed partakes of teruma, the Sages rendered it prohibited for her to do so, lest she allow other members of her family to eat it.
